title: Decoupled self-assembled monolayer and perovskite deposition for efficient flexible solar modules
title_zh: 分离自组装单层与钙钛矿沉积实现高效柔性太阳能模块
abstract: The power conversion efficiency (PCE) and stability of flexible perovskite solar modules (PSMs) are less than those of their rigid devices because surface hydroxyls desorption on flexible substrates, which disrupts self-assembled monolayer (SAM) anchoring and perovskite crystallization. We developed a decoupled SAM-perovskite codeposition strategy that accelerates SAM anchoring by reducing the SAM-perovskite interaction and ameliorates perovskite crystallization. The certified PCE with phenethylammonium iodide as the passivation molecule was 20.2% on PSMs with device areas of 750 cm 2 . With 1,3-diaminopropane dihydroiodide as the passivator, the PCE of 22.0% for a device area of 14.55 cm 2 decreased by 8% after 1044 hours under maximum power point tracking at 85°C and 65% relative humidity. The devices pass all sequences of an international commercialization assessment standard for flexible portable PSMs.
abstract_zh: 柔性钙钛矿太阳能模块（PSMs）的光电转换效率（PCE）和稳定性低于其刚性设备，这是因为柔性基底表面羟基的脱附破坏了自组装单层（SAM）的锚定和钙钛矿晶体的成核。我们开发了一种分离式 SAM-钙钛矿共沉积策略，通过降低 SAM 与钙钛矿的相互作用来加速 SAM 的锚定，并改善钙钛矿的结晶。使用苯乙胺碘化物作为钝化分子，认证的 PCE 在 750 cm² 设备面积上达到 20.2%。使用 1,3-二氨丙胺二氢碘化物作为钝化剂，14.55 cm² 设备面积的 PCE 为 22.0%，在 85 °C、65% 相对湿度下最大功率点跟踪 1044 小时后下降 8%。这些设备通过了柔性便携式 PSM 的国际商业化评估标准的所有序列。
